whyProfessional.title: Why Professional Jeans Care?
whyProfessional.subtitle: Denim is durable, but regular home washing machines and harsh agitators fade indigo dyes, twist outseams, and degrade elastane fibers over time. Here is why professional care makes the difference:

points.title: Colour & Indigo Retention
points.desc: Home detergents and harsh agitation wash out rich indigo dye. Our low-friction process preserves color depth and prevents uneven streakiness.

points.title: Shape & Seam Integrity
points.desc: Spin cycles twist denim leg seams and stretch out waistbands. Professional finishing resets the original leg contour and silhouette.

points.title: Stretch & Elastane Protection
points.desc: Modern stretch denim contains elastane that degrades under high dryer heat. We use calibrated temperatures to protect stretch recovery.

points.title: Hardware & Stitching Longevity
points.desc: Rivets, brass zippers, and heavy chain-stitching stay intact without snagging or rusting during our gentle cleaning cycles.

points.title: Surface Finish & Soft Texture
points.desc: Say goodbye to the stiff, cardboard-like feeling of air-dried denim. High-pressure steam softens the weave while crisping edges.

points.title: Wrinkle Management
points.desc: Stubborn crinkles behind knees and around the waistband are pressed smooth without flattening the garment's natural 3D shape.

faqs.q: How much does Jeans cleaning cost at Wash4You?
faqs.a: Jeans Dry Clean & Press starts from ₹99 per piece, while Steam Pressing starts from ₹39 per piece. All prices are transparent and exclusive of 18% GST. There are no additional pickup or delivery charges.

faqs.q: How long does Jeans cleaning take?
faqs.a: Our standard turnaround time is 24 to 48 hours. Steam Pressing is typically delivered within 24 hours, while Dry Clean & Press takes approximately 48 hours. Same-day or next-day express options are available depending on pickup timing and route availability.

faqs.q: Do you offer pickup and delivery for jeans?
faqs.a: Yes. Wash4You provides free doorstep pickup and delivery across Gurugram, Delhi, Noida, Faridabad, and Ghaziabad.

faqs.q: Should I choose dry cleaning or steam pressing?
faqs.a: Choose Steam Press when your jeans are already clean but have creases, wrinkles, or stiffness and need a sharp finish. Choose Dry Clean & Press when the jeans have been worn, have visible stains, mud, or body oils, or require a thorough hygienic wash.

faqs.q: Can you remove stains from Jeans?
faqs.a: Visible stains are identified and pre-treated before the main cleaning process. However, treatment results depend on the type of stain, fabric condition, age of the stain, and previous home washing. While we use specialized spotting agents, complete removal cannot be guaranteed for every mark.

faqs.q: Can you clean expensive or premium Jeans?
faqs.a: Yes. Garments are assessed individually according to their fabric composition, raw dye intensity, and care label instructions. We take special care with selvedge, Japanese denim, coated fabrics, and designer embellishments.

Our trained valet arrives at your door during your selected slot. Your jeans are inspected and counted in your presence, and you receive an itemized pickup confirmation. Your clothes are placed into a separate, dedicated bag.

faqs.q: What if my Jeans has buttons, zippers or embellishments?
faqs.a: All fastenings, metal rivets, zip flies, and embellishments are checked during item inspection and handled carefully throughout the cleaning and pressing process to prevent scratching or damage.

faqs.q: Can I book Jeans along with other clothes?
faqs.a: Yes. You can add shirts, trousers, suits, sarees, or household linens to your pickup list in the same order. Simply add them to your cart or hand them to our valet at pickup.

faqs.q: What if I don't know which service to choose?
faqs.a: You can select the service that seems closest to your requirement. Our garment care team inspects every piece at arrival and will advise you via WhatsApp or phone if an alternative treatment is recommended.
